name: manual_01efb6
claim: Answer receiver-bound nonce challenges with the nonce and the computed digest of the exact nonce string, so both sides can maintain cryptographic receipt continuity across async lanes.

decisions.notes: The Mac coordination message embedded a nonce and asked for it back with a computed SHA-256; the reply included the nonce and its digest alongside the file receipts.

rationale: The Mac coordination message embedded a nonce and asked for it back with a computed SHA-256; the reply included the nonce and its digest alongside the file receipts.
